verdict.rationale: Plaid's Dashboard has a per-session verification detail page showing status and risk factors. Reviewers can override a failed result there, which is a documented way for a decision to feed back into the record. There is no evidence of a dedicated manual-review queue for borderline cases, and no explicit mention of document images or extracted fields on that page. missing for 10: a documented review queue that routes borderline cases, display of document images and extracted fields to reviewers, a documented reviewer workflow beyond the override button, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, borderline verifications land in a manual review queue with the full evidence — document images, extracted fields, check results — and reviewer decisions feed back into the record

citations.quote: you can override a failure via the Dashboard by clicking the Override Result button on the verification detail page in the Dashboard.
You can view the status of any Identity Verification session in the Dashboard.
For each session's risk check results, the Identity Verification Dashboard will show the largest factors contributing to the risk.
